CREATE TABLE directory_projection_states (
	instance_uuid VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	cursor BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_coverage_cursor BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, 
	last_applied_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	lease_expires_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (instance_uuid), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_directory_projection_state_cursor CHECK (cursor >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_directory_projection_state_snapshot_coverage CHECK (snapshot_coverage_cursor >= 0 AND snapshot_coverage_cursor <= cursor), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_directory_projection_state_fingerprint CHECK (length(snapshot_fingerprint) = 64)
)

CREATE TABLE directory_projection_inbox (
	instance_uuid VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	event_uuid VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	cursor BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	revision BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, 
	received_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	applied_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (instance_uuid, event_uuid), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_directory_projection_inbox_cursor UNIQUE (instance_uuid, cursor), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_directory_projection_inbox_cursor CHECK (cursor > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_directory_projection_inbox_revision CHECK (revision > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_directory_projection_inbox_fingerprint CHECK (length(fingerprint) = 64)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_directory_projection_inbox_pending ON directory_projection_inbox (instance_uuid, applied_at, cursor)

CREATE TABLE metadata (
	"key" VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	value VARCHAR(255), 
	PRIMARY KEY ("key")
)

CREATE TABLE users (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	uuid VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	normalized_email VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL, 
	password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'local' NOT NULL, 
	projection_revision BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	account_type VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'local' NOT NULL, 
	space_account_uuid VARCHAR(255), 
	space_access_token TEXT, 
	space_refresh_token TEXT, 
	space_access_token_expires_at DATETIME, 
	space_api_key VARCHAR(255), 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_users_normalized_email CHECK (normalized_email = trim(normalized_email) AND length(normalized_email) > 0 AND length(normalized_email) <= 320), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_users_status CHECK (status IN ('active', 'disabled', 'deleted')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_users_source CHECK (source IN ('local', 'cloud_projection'))
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_users_uuid ON users (uuid)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_users_normalized_email ON users (normalized_email)

CREATE TABLE passkey_credentials (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	uuid VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	account_uuid VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	credential_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	public_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sign_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	aaguid VARCHAR(64), 
	transports VARCHAR(255), 
	backed_up BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	last_used_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_uuid) REFERENCES users (uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_passkey_credentials_cred_id ON passkey_credentials (credential_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_passkey_credentials_uuid ON passkey_credentials (uuid)
CREATE INDEX ix_passkey_credentials_account ON passkey_credentials (account_uuid)

CREATE TABLE workspaces (
	uuid VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	instance_uuid VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'team' NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL, 
	created_by_account_uuid VARCHAR(36), 
	source VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'local' NOT NULL, 
	projection_revision BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (uuid), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_workspaces_instance_slug UNIQUE (instance_uuid, slug), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_workspaces_type CHECK (type IN ('personal', 'team')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_workspaces_status CHECK (status IN ('provisioning', 'active', 'suspended', 'archived', 'deleted')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_workspaces_source CHECK (source IN ('local', 'cloud_projection')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by_account_uuid) REFERENCES users (uuid) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_workspaces_local_instance ON workspaces (instance_uuid) WHERE source = 'local'
CREATE INDEX ix_workspaces_instance_status ON workspaces (instance_uuid, status)

CREATE TABLE api_keys (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	uuid VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	workspace_uuid VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_by_account_uuid VARCHAR(36), 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	scopes JSON DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME, 
	last_used_at DATETIME, 
	description VARCHAR(512), 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_api_keys_status CHECK (status IN ('active', 'revoked')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(workspace_uuid) REFERENCES workspaces (uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by_account_uuid) REFERENCES users (uuid) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
CREATE INDEX ix_api_keys_workspace_name ON api_keys (workspace_uuid, name)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_api_keys_key_hash ON api_keys (key_hash)
CREATE INDEX ix_api_keys_workspace_status ON api_keys (workspace_uuid, status)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_api_keys_uuid ON api_keys (uuid)

)

CREATE TABLE workspace_memberships (
	uuid VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	workspace_uuid VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	account_uuid VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL, 
	invited_by_account_uuid VARCHAR(36), 
	joined_at DATETIME, 
	source VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'local' NOT NULL, 
	projection_revision BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (uuid), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_workspace_membership_account UNIQUE (workspace_uuid, account_uuid), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_workspace_memberships_role CHECK (role IN ('owner', 'admin', 'developer', 'operator', 'viewer')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_workspace_memberships_status CHECK (status IN ('active', 'disabled', 'removed')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_workspace_memberships_source CHECK (source IN ('local', 'cloud_projection')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(workspace_uuid) REFERENCES workspaces (uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_uuid) REFERENCES users (uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(invited_by_account_uuid) REFERENCES users (uuid) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
CREATE INDEX ix_workspace_memberships_account_status ON workspace_memberships (account_uuid, status)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_workspace_memberships_one_active_owner ON workspace_memberships (workspace_uuid) WHERE role = 'owner' AND status = 'active'

CREATE TABLE workspace_invitations (
	uuid VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	workspace_uuid VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	normalized_email VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	token_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	accepted_at DATETIME, 
	revoked_at DATETIME, 
	created_by_account_uuid VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (uuid), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_workspace_invitations_role CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'developer', 'operator', 'viewer')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_workspace_invitations_status CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'accepted', 'revoked', 'expired')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(workspace_uuid) REFERENCES workspaces (uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by_account_uuid) REFERENCES users (uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_workspace_invitations_token_hash ON workspace_invitations (token_hash)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_workspace_invitations_pending_email ON workspace_invitations (workspace_uuid, normalized_email) WHERE status = 'pending'

CREATE TABLE workspace_execution_states (
	workspace_uuid VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE workspace_memberships (
	uuid VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	workspace_uuid VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	account_uuid VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL, 
	invited_by_account_uuid VARCHAR(36), 
	joined_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	source VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'local' NOT NULL, 
	projection_revision BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (uuid), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_workspace_membership_account UNIQUE (workspace_uuid, account_uuid), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_workspace_memberships_role CHECK (role IN ('owner', 'admin', 'developer', 'operator', 'viewer')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_workspace_memberships_status CHECK (status IN ('active', 'disabled', 'removed')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_workspace_memberships_source CHECK (source IN ('local', 'cloud_projection')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(workspace_uuid) REFERENCES workspaces (uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_uuid) REFERENCES users (uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(invited_by_account_uuid) REFERENCES users (uuid) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
CREATE INDEX ix_workspace_memberships_account_status ON workspace_memberships (account_uuid, status)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_workspace_memberships_one_active_owner ON workspace_memberships (workspace_uuid) WHERE role = 'owner' AND status = 'active'

	revoked_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	created_by_account_uuid VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (uuid), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_workspace_invitations_role CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'developer', 'operator', 'viewer')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_workspace_invitations_status CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'accepted', 'revoked', 'expired')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(workspace_uuid) REFERENCES workspaces (uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by_account_uuid) REFERENCES users (uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_workspace_invitations_token_hash ON workspace_invitations (token_hash)
